title:
Used to handle user navigating away from create metric workflow.
The epic handles following things:
1. Force redirect to create metric page: On 'Reliability.CreateMetricPageTitle.ACTIVE_TAB_SET', the epic
     - Starts listening to any GLOBAL_REDIRECT's happening and force redirects user back to create metric page via
       a {@link NavigationHelper#handleForceBackRedirect}.
     - The epic also stores the page user originally intended to navigate to in application state and opens a warning
       modal.
     - Stops helper from listening, when GLOBAL_REDIRECT is fired with payload having 'exitAnyway' parameter set to+
       true.

2. Exit anyway from create metric page: On 'GLOBAL_REDIRECT' with 'exitAnyway' set to true, the epic
     Fires 'GLOBAL_REDIRECT' to page user originally intended to navigate to and clear relevant application and
     component state.
name: ExitCreateReliabilityMetricEpic
